title: Ukrainian-Style Italian Sfoglia
description: A traditional Italian pastry reimagined with Ukrainian flair, featuring a robust and flaky crust.
instructions: 2. Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
3. Cut the dough into desired shapes (e.g., triangles, squares, or circles).
4. In a small bowl, mix the robust coffee and flaky sea salt (if using).
5. Brush the pastry shapes with the coffee mixture, leaving a 1/2 inch (1 cm) border around the edges.
6. Bake the pastry for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
7. While the pastry is baking, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
8. In a separate bowl, mix the Ukrainian honey and whipped cream.
9. Once the pastry is done, allow it to cool for a few minutes before drizzling with the honey-cream mixture.
10. Top with fresh berries and serve immediately.
